name: music_play
summary: Play music: a song, artist, genre, mood or playlist on YouTube (default; a genre or mood starts a playlist), Spotify, or Apple Music (songs and playlists in the user's own library). Also pause / resume / next / stop what is playing: it knows where the music plays.

args.query: string: what to play ('some jazz', 'Nina Simone', 'lofi for working', 'Blue in Green by Miles Davis'); empty for pause / resume / next / stop
args.service: youtube | spotify | music (Apple Music; optional, only when the user names it)
args.action: play | pause | resume | next | stop (optional, default play)
